actions.reason: Cache the nested merge lookup on the tokenizer and reuse it across encode calls, invalidating it when the merges mapping is replaced or changes size. This avoids rebuilding the same lookup for repeated encodes while preserving identical token outputs.

candidate.patch:
diff --git a/minbpe/base.py b/minbpe/base.py
--- a/minbpe/base.py
+++ b/minbpe/base.py
@@ -92,11 +92,29 @@ class Tokenizer:
 
     def __init__(self):
         # default: vocab size of 256 (all bytes), no merges, no patterns
+        self._merge_lookup = None
+        self._merge_lookup_size = -1
         self.merges = {} # (int, int) -> int
         self.pattern = "" # str
         self.special_tokens = {} # str -> int, e.g. {'<|endoftext|>': 100257}
         self.vocab = self._build_vocab() # int -> bytes
 
+    @property
+    def merges(self):
+        return self._merges
+
+    @merges.setter
+    def merges(self, merges):
+        self._merges = merges
+        self._merge_lookup = None
+        self._merge_lookup_size = -1
+
+    def _get_merge_lookup(self):
+        if self._merge_lookup is None or self._merge_lookup_size != len(self.merges):
+            self._merge_lookup = build_merge_lookup(self.merges)
+            self._merge_lookup_size = len(self.merges)
+        return self._merge_lookup
+
     def train(self, text, vocab_size, verbose=False):
         # Tokenizer can train a vocabulary of size vocab_size from text
         raise NotImplementedError
